close_reason:
Added one populated /get decode test per data type, mirroring calendar_get_smoke shape:
- chat_get_decodes_populated_chat: Chat with kind, name, members (with optional invitedBy), pinnedMessageIds, lastMessageAt
- space_get_decodes_populated_space: Space with description, roles, members, categories (each populated), uncategorizedChannelIds
- message_get_decodes_populated_message: Message with attachments, mentions, reactions (HashMap entry), replyTo, editedAt; also exercises SenderId manual Deserialize 'self' -> Owner sentinel

Each test asserts on every required field plus representative optionals and at least one entry in each nested collection. Regression in any of the typed Deserialize impls (Chat/Space/Message or any nested type) will surface.

All 3 new tests pass. cargo test -p jmap-chat-client green. cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-client --tests -- -D warnings clean. cargo fmt clean.

Committed as a804dd8.
description: tests/chat_smoke_tests.rs:39,106; tests/space_smoke_tests.rs:32; tests/message_smoke_tests.rs:62 — every /get-shaped mock returns `"list": []`. None of the smoke tests exercise the response-decoding path with a populated Chat/Space/Message wire object. Sibling crate-jmap-calendars-client/tests/calendar_smoke_tests.rs::calendar_get_smoke builds a fully-populated Calendar JSON and asserts on resp.list[0].{id,name,is_default}. The chat-client /get tests would still pass if the Deserialize impls were completely broken. Workspace test-integrity principle violated: 'tests that always pass by construction.' Fix: add at least one /get test per data type (Chat, Space, Message) that returns a populated wire object and asserts on the parsed fields. Mirror calendar_get_smoke shape.
title: /get response decoding has zero smoke-test coverage
